name: Battonya (Hungary)
description: White field with a yellow horizontal stripe along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the town arms of Battonya: a shield of red and blue with a black eagle crest, with red and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Battonya arms with crest and mantling
